name: [SF-07] "STEM-Fish"
desc:
[CLASS] -- "Canid"
[LAST WORDS] -- "...All right. I understand."
[ODDS] -- "0.067%"
[NOTE] -- "This project went far past its regular budget.
quirks:
[Canid Mark+] -- Your gut can barely process theobromine. Coffee, chocolate and energy drinks are far more toxic to you than to other SAWs.
[Reworked Frame] -- Muscle-related genes were modified: under the same conditions you can carry far more than a standard experiment. Very useful when you are loaded down with gear.
[Aquatic Adaptation] -- Your bone density is lower than a SAW's, so you move more freely in water.
[Bioluminescence] -- In an emergency, you are the light source. Apparently this has been an old bug in the company's gene projects for a long time.
[Chip] -- You cannot start without a chip. But there will be a way.
[Special Training] -- You handle firearms with practiced ease. (Stronger R-key handling)
[Extra Supplies] -- You are issued special starting equipment so they can test combat data.
[Terminal Tablet] -- You carry a tablet that monitors more data, and lets you write things down.
[Latecomer] -- Too many experiments have already been released; the planet's ecology has changed. You will need more ammunition.
[Self-Awareness] -- Genes closer to a human brain gave you higher intelligence and a real sense of self. It also means you refuse to go after other experiments.
